An '''Imperial''' took part in the [[Battle of the Sixela system]] against the forces of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was onboard [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Interdictor Star Destroyer]] during the battle and communicated with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] when she tried to stop the fighting.

==Biography==
A number of months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] betrayed the Empire and fled retribution. In his exile, the former [[Officer/Legends|officer]] hatched a plan to take his revenge upon both sides of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Soresh would draw the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] to the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]] under false pretenses while at the same time trapping them with elements of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

This Imperial was accompanied [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to lead a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]] to the Sixela system. When the Rebel fleet came out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the Imperial fleet was ready. Trapping the Rebels with [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction fields]], the Imperial fleet engaged in brutal ship-to-ship [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] with the opposing fleet, while Darth Vader landed on the planet to pursue Soresh.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

When Rebellion leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] escaped Soresh's compound on his [[Unidentified dead red moon|barren moon]], she contacted Vader's [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Interdictor Star Destroyer]], which acted as the fleet's flagship; Organa reached this Imperial. She attempted to warn him of Soresh's plan to annihilate the system's [[Star/Legends|star]] with [[resonance torpedo]]es. The only response the Imperial gave her was an angry tirade against the Rebellion. Organa cut off the channel when he laughed at her warning.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

After Soresh's torpedoes reached the sun, it became apparent that the system would be destroyed, even though Soresh was already dead. Both fleets fled into hyperspace before the sun went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], vaporizing everything in the local area.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Personality and traits==
When this Imperial was contacted by Organa, he referred to her as "Rebel scum" and demanded her surrender. He refused to believe her warnings, offering a sharp bark of laughter.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Imperial was introduced as a background character in the final book of [[Alex Wheeler]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />
